content: संनिपातः .²1 Falling down, alighting, descent. .²2 Falling together, meeting; confluence; समुद्रपत्न्योर्जलसंनिपाते <ls>R. 13. 58</ls>. .²3 Collision, contact; संनिपातावधूतैश्च <ls>Mb. 4. 13. 27</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> संनिपातोऽङ्गसंघट्टनम्); प्रतिपदमविहस्ताः संनिपाते रिपूणाम् <ls>Śiva B. 30. 47</ls>. .²4 Union, conjunction, combination, mixture, miscellaneous collection; तथा तयोः संनिपातः शरयोरभवत्तदा <ls>Mb. 3. 39. 15</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 11. 25. 6</ls>; धूमज्योतिःसलिलमरुतां संनिपातः क्व मेथः <ls>Me. 5</ls>. .²5 An assemblage, a collection, multitude, number; नानारत्नज्योतिषां संनिपातैः <ls>Ki. 5. 36</ls>; एको हि दोषो गुणसंनिपाते निमज्जति <ls>Ku. 1. 3</ls>. .²6 Arrival. .²7 A combined derangement of the three humours of the body causing fever which is of a dangerous kind. .²8 A kind of musical time or measure. .²9 Sexual intercourse; <ls>Mb. 5</ls>. .²10 Battle, war. .²11 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) A particular conjunction of planets.
